SUFFICE_WORKSPACE="$PWD" node <<'NODE'
const assert = require('node:assert/strict')
const semver = require('./src')
const includePrerelease = { includePrerelease: true }
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.0.3-alpha', '^0.0.3', includePrerelease), false)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.2.3-alpha', '^0.2.3', includePrerelease), false)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('1.2.3-alpha', '^1.2.3', includePrerelease), false)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.0.3', '^0.0.3', includePrerelease), true)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.0.4-alpha', '^0.0.3', includePrerelease), false)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.2.3-alpha', '^0.2.x', includePrerelease), true)
assert.equal(semver.satisfies('0.2.3-alpha', '^0.2.3-alpha', includePrerelease), true)
console.log('caret prerelease checks passed')
NODE
